title.en: Delete an IM group invitation link

descriptions.zh:
><notice>通过API删除IM群邀请链接功能属于Meta内测功能，请联系您的商务经理申请加白。></notice>

- 在调用此接口之前，请确保您创建的IM群已添加IM群邀请链接。

- 若您没有已创建成功的IM群，可通过[AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~)、[AddChatGroupInviteLink](~~3019211~~)接口创建并添加IM群邀请链接。

- 在删除IM群邀请链接后，IM群将无法邀请成员进入，请谨慎操作。
descriptions.en:
><notice>The ability to delete IM group invitation links through the API is a Meta beta feature. Contact your account manager to request access.></notice>

- Before calling this operation, make sure that the IM group you created already has an IM group invitation link added.

- If you do not have an existing IM group, call the [AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~) and [AddChatGroupInviteLink](~~3019211~~) operations to create an IM group and add an invitation link.

- After you delete an IM group invitation link, the IM group can no longer invite members to join. Proceed with caution.
